checkedAlternates.risk: Brown dwarfs share the word dwarf with white dwarfs.
checkedAlternates.resolution: Brown dwarfs never sustained hydrogen fusion (group-1), whereas white dwarfs are fusion-exhausted stellar cores (group-2).
A magnetar is a neutron star with an ultra-strong magnetic field (group-3), not a black hole (group-4).
